text: Imaging medicine and nuclear medicine are interdisciplinary fields that integrate medical imaging (such as X-rays, CT, MRI, ultrasound, etc.) and nuclear medicine (such as radionuclide imaging, PET-CT, etc.), dedicated to non-invasive imaging diagnosis, functional assessment and targeted therapy of diseases. Through the study of this major, students willMaster the principles, image interpretation and clinical applications of various imaging techniques;Be familiar with the research and development of radioactive drugs in nuclear medicine, molecular imaging technology and radiation protection regulations;Possess the interventional diagnosis and treatment ability guided by images, and cultivate the clinical thinking of "precise diagnosis - precise treatment".
